title: i’d put the AI tutor inside the teacher’s workflow
description: Why AI tutors earn trust when goals, notes, and next actions stay inside the teacher’s workflow.
tldr: AI tutors become easier to trust when they live inside the teacher’s workflow. Set the goal, save tutor notes in the same record, and keep the next action visible there.

sections.h2: where should an AI tutor live during a teaching session?
body: i’d put it inside the teacher’s workflow, where the session already has its context and follow-up.
That keeps the tutor connected to the work the teacher is already doing.

sections.h2: what should the teacher define before the session starts?
body: set the goal before the session. A clear goal gives the tutor and teacher a shared point of reference.
The goal also makes the session easier to understand after it ends.

sections.h2: what makes an AI tutor feel accountable after the session?
body: save tutor notes in the same record and make the next action visible there too.
That puts context and accountability in one place. That’s where trust starts.

faqs.q: how do you build trust in an AI tutor?
faqs.a: Put the AI tutor inside the teacher’s workflow. Keep the goal, tutor notes, and next action connected in one place.

faqs.q: what should an AI tutor record after a session?
faqs.a: The tutor should save its notes in the same record as the session. The next action should be visible there too.

faqs.q: why should the session goal be set in advance?
faqs.a: A goal gives the session a clear direction. It also keeps the tutor’s work connected to what the teacher intended to accomplish.
